seo.title: Service Areas in Greater Victoria | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping serves 13 Greater Victoria communities, from Sidney and North Saanich to Langford, Sooke and Metchosin. Find your area and get a free quote.

lede: Thirteen municipalities across Greater Victoria. Each area page covers local neighbourhoods and the tree and watering rules that apply.

sections.heading: Local rules differ
body: Tree bylaws differ by municipality, and CRD watering rules apply where a property is on the regional supply. Read our [winter pruning and tree permit guide](/resources/winter-pruning-and-storm-prep/).

sections.heading: Not on the list?
body: If you're nearby, [get a free quote](/quote/) and choose Other, or [contact us](/contact/). See [our services](/services/).
